company.name: A & J Williams (Yorkshire)
company.distributes: Chemist confectionery and sugar free sweets (Cavendish & Harvey travel tins, Jakemans, Halls, Lockets, Melody Pops) next to over 1,200 OTC, toiletry, first aid, household and personal care lines sold in case quantities.
company.channels_supplied: Independent pharmacies throughout the UK, plus other retailers buying fast moving everyday lines; ordering by sales force, trade website and mobile app.
company.sf_brands_carried: Has a dedicated Sugar Free category, including Cavendish & Harvey sugar free drops.
what_they_do_well: Family owned and run independent pharmacy wholesaler trading since 1989.
Reaches pharmacies through its own salesforce, a trade website and a mobile ordering app.
company.fit_rationale: A family-run independent wholesaler whose business is supplying independent pharmacies with counter lines, and it already runs both a confectionery and a sugar free category, so Diablo's sugar free sweets, chocolate and bars would sit in an existing pharmacy shelf range. Scale: supplies independent pharmacies throughout the UK with over 1,200 branded lines, a salesforce, a trade-only B2B website and app, and exhibits at The Pharmacy Show. Storage: trade ordering from stock in case quantities through its registered-account B2B shop, with carriage free delivery to pharmacies.

company.name: Albatross Food
company.distributes: Sweets (Broadway Sweets; Trade Kings Super Sweets, Amazon Chews, Soccer Chews and Monsta Pops lollipops; Toros sweets), biscuits and snacks (National Brands), plus cereals (Kellogg's), noodles, canned foods and drinks from Tiger Brands, Galaxy Foods, Brand Club and others
company.channels_supplied: 4,550+ Western Cape customers: 450+ distributors, wholesalers and cash and carries, and 4,100+ chain stores, tuck shops, superettes, spaza shops and forecourts, including Pick n Pay Family, Spar Family and OK Mini Markets stores
what_they_do_well: Reaches 4,100+ chain stores, tuck shops, superettes, spaza shops and forecourts across the Western Cape.
Supplies chain stores such as Pick n Pay Family, Spar Family and OK Mini Markets with a 48-hour delivery cycle.
company.fit_rationale: A Western Cape FMCG field distributor that already takes branded sweets and biscuits to thousands of spaza shops, tuck shops, superettes and forecourts, with its own sales, promotion and merchandising team. Diablo's sugar-free sweets and biscuits would sit next to the Trade Kings, Broadway and National Brands lines it already sells into that trade. Scale: 4,550+ customers across the Western Cape, from Cape Town to Vredendal, George and Beaufort West. Storage: delivers to its customers on a 48-hour cycle from its Montague Gardens base in Cape Town, with minimum orders for Cape Town and up-country deliveries.

company.name: Candy Theatre (3 Aces London Ltd)
company.distributes: International confectionery, chocolate, sweets, snacks and drinks, over 2,000 lines: Hershey's, Reese's, M&M's, Haribo, Oreo, Warheads, Sour Patch Kids, Nerds and Airheads.
company.channels_supplied: Convenience stores and independent retailers nationwide; over 1,200 convenience stores and 5,000+ trade customers on trade accounts.
what_they_do_well: Supplies over 1,200 convenience stores nationwide with international confectionery and drinks since 2019.
Exhibits at IFE London as a wholesaler and distributor of international confectionery and beverages.
company.fit_rationale: A London wholesaler and distributor of international confectionery that sells branded chocolate, sweets and snacks to convenience stores across the UK. Diablo's sugar-free chocolate, gummies and biscuits would sit next to the American and European brands its trade customers already buy. Scale: over 5,000 trade customers and more than 1,200 convenience stores nationwide, with 2 to 3 day delivery across the UK. Storage: a B2B web shop with stock and trade prices, dispatched within 24 hours from its unit at Harlequin Industrial Park, Southall.

company.name: Kitwave
company.distributes: Impulse confectionery, snacks, soft drinks, grocery, tobacco, frozen and chilled food and foodservice lines.
company.channels_supplied: Independent retailers, convenience stores, vending (Automatic Retailing), schools and colleges and foodservice; subsidiaries include M&M Value (North Shields and Middlesbrough), Eden Farm, Teatime Tasties and Squirrels.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1988 as a regional confectionery business and grown into a national wholesaler with 27 depots.
Its M&M Value business won the snacks, confectionery and soft drinks lot for Sunderland College in 2021.
company.fit_rationale: Kitwave was founded in North Shields as a confectionery wholesaler and remains headquartered on Tyneside, so it combines local reach with national scale through 27 depots. Its M&M Value arm already wins confectionery and snacks contracts in the region, which suits a sugar-free line for schools and colleges.

company.name: Route To Market Solutions (RTMS)
company.distributes: Chocolate (Cadbury, Nestle, Bar One), sweets and gum (Perfetti Van Melle, Mister Sweet), crisps, snacks and treats, energy bars, rusks, fruit and nuts and drinks from 92 suppliers including Tiger Brands, Kellogg's, Pioneer Foods, RCL Foods and Red Bull
company.channels_supplied: Over 1,000 convenience outlets: forecourts, stores, schools and pharmacies, mainly in the Western Cape, with partner distributors in the NDS alliance for national reach
what_they_do_well: Runs a 6,000 m2 warehouse and 20 delivery vehicles serving over 1,000 convenience outlets.
Cape Town member of the NDS alliance of 10 distributors serving about 7,800 forecourt and general trade customers.
company.fit_rationale: A convenience channel distributor that handles sales, warehousing and delivery to forecourts, school tuck shops, stores and pharmacies, already carrying Cadbury, Nestle and Perfetti Van Melle confectionery. Diablo's sugar-free chocolate, sweets and bars suit its forecourt and school customers, and its NDS partners give a path to other provinces. Scale: 1,000 customers, 130 staff, 2,876 products from 92 suppliers, mainly across the Western Cape. Storage: a 6,000 m2 warehouse and 20 delivery vehicles, with an online trade ordering portal.

company.name: Smooth Wholesales
company.distributes: Branded confectionery (gummies, sour candy, chocolate and counter lines such as Nerds, Trolli, Warheads, Sour Patch, Chupa Chups, Zappo), imported USA snacks (Takis, Cheetos, Herr's) and drinks (Monster, Dr Pepper, Arizona), plus impulse non-food lines.
company.channels_supplied: Petrol and convenience stores, newsagencies and post offices, tobacconists, independent grocers and Foodworks stores, and pharmacies across Australia.
what_they_do_well: Supplies more than 2,500 independent retailers across Australia from one Melbourne site.
Brings viral imported USA snacks and confectionery such as Takis and Warheads to petrol and convenience counters.
company.fit_rationale: Moorabbin wholesaler built for the impulse trade, already selling branded sweets and snacks to petrol, convenience and newsagency counters where Diablo's bars, gummies and chocolate fit directly. Its trade portal and existing imported confectionery range make adding a European sugar-free range simple. Scale: more than 2,500 retailers supplied across Australia, about 1,000 to 2,000 wholesale lines. Storage: showroom and dispatch from 29 Levanswell Road, Moorabbin, with stocked lines shipped to stores through an ABN trade account portal.

company.name: Supersaves Distributors
company.distributes: Sweets and gummies (Tasty Treats, Jolly Smax), biscuits and wafers (Tasty Treats Wafers, Choc Double Velvet, Ginger Biscuits, Choco Rings, Cookies), chips and savoury snacks (Pico, KRIT, Saltee, Cheezy Bites, Chipniks) and cold drinks (Score, Frooty Boost), all from other companies' brands.
company.channels_supplied: Trade customers across the Western Cape that open a business account; individual store names are not published.
what_they_do_well: Has grown from a small client network into distribution across the Western Cape since separating from Supersave's Food & Meat Market in 2019.
company.fit_rationale: A Cape Town distributor of branded sweets, biscuits, wafers and chips for shops, already selling value confectionery and biscuit brands into the Western Cape trade. Diablo's sweets, biscuits and wafers would sit next to its existing lines. Scale: products distributed across the Western Cape region, with a trade account application for new business customers; trading since 1992 under Supersave's Food & Meat Market and independent since 2019. Storage: trading premises at 131 Cradock Road, Steenberg, Cape Town, from which it delivers to client stores.

company.name: Supplyer Ltd
company.distributes: Branded FMCG: confectionery, chocolate, sugar sweets, biscuits and snacks (Cadbury, Trebor, Halls, Fox's, Gullón) alongside household and personal care brands such as Persil, Fairy, Dettol and Dove.
company.channels_supplied: Small independent retailers across the UK, plus food-to-go and catering formats; some direct-to-consumer sales.
what_they_do_well: Takes title to stock and runs its own 8,000 sq ft warehouse, giving brands one trade account and shops one delivery.
company.fit_rationale: Supplyer buys branded goods outright and resells them to independent shops nationwide, with confectionery, chocolate and biscuits named as a core area next to household lines. It is a young and compact business, so it suits a first listing of Diablo's core chocolate, sweets and biscuits. Scale: delivers next day to independent retailers across the UK, 138 brand partners and about 1,500 SKUs, trading since 2020. Storage: 8,000 sq ft warehouse in the West Midlands run in-house with date coding and FEFO rotation.

company.name: United Wholesale (Scotland)
company.distributes: Confectionery, biscuits, crisps and snacks alongside grocery, impulse, household, chilled and licensed ranges, sold in trade cases and multipacks from branded suppliers.
company.channels_supplied: Independent convenience stores, its Day-Today, Day-Today Express, Day-Today Elite and USave symbol stores (over 500 in Scotland), plus pubs, clubs and caterers.
what_they_do_well: Built the Day-Today symbol group from a 30-store launch in 2005 to over 500 Day-Today and USave stores in Scotland.
company.fit_rationale: A Scottish cash and carry and delivered wholesaler that runs the Day-Today and USave symbol groups, so one listing reaches hundreds of independent shops across central Scotland. Its promotion leaflets carry confectionery, biscuits and crisps and snacks sections. Scale: over 500 symbol stores in Scotland and three depots covering Glasgow, Stirlingshire, Fife and the Lothians. Storage: three cash and carry depots, including a 170,000 sq ft site at Queenslie, plus a delivered service since 2003.
